notes.title: 🎮 The Amerzone Demo is Back 🕊️
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

As 2024 grows to a close, we’ve decided to give you a gift ahead of Christmas.

[h2]You can now play the new Demo of Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062200/Amerzone__The_Explorers_Legacy_Demo/

[h3]What’s new in this Demo?[/h3]

[list][*]The Demo lasts longer: you’ll now play until discovering the Hydrafloat
[*]Many bugs & crashes have been fixed
[*]Performances have been improved
[*]Saves are now compatible with the full game
[*]Do note that although the Demo is playable on Steam Deck, [b]it isn’t fully compatible[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44915176/12f496b9f478c0e77435cfead3f167333ef77214.jpg[/img]

🕊️ [b]Wishlist Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy now[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429190/Amerzone__The_Explorers_Legacy/

📬 [b]Stay connected![/b]

notes.title: 3 new languages now available
notes.content:
Hello Syberia fans!

Good news today since we just added 3 new languages to the game:
- Italian
- Japanese
- Polish

Syberia is still growing with these new languages and we hope you'll enjoy playing the game in your own language, thank you!
